args.lesson: For Apify PPE ideas, fetch docs.apify.com/actors/monetize/pay-per-event at verdict time. It gives the exact developer formula (80% of event revenue minus platform costs, free-plan users excluded), and break-even seconds per event follow directly from the memory size. Margin per event is rarely the constraint for light utilities; volume of paid-plan users is. Set memory limits in actor.json before the first build.
